about.metaDescription: I'm Enzo, a full-stack web developer. Learn more about my programming journey.
about.name: Enzo N. Barata
about.headline: Full-stack web developer • Computer Science student (UFJF)
about.intro: My name is Enzo, I'm 20 years old, and I was born and live in Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, Brazil. I code for passion and for work, but I've enjoyed creating things since I was little. As a child, I used cardboard, paper and drawings to invent things, so imagination and creativity have always been part of my life. Over time, I became fascinated by the audiovisual world, which led me to explore creating and editing photos and videos. Although I still enjoy that field, I realised that what I really love is creating through software development.
about.earlyProgramming: I started programming by making little games with PowerPoint and VBA when I was 11, in 2017. Back then, I just copied and pasted code without really understanding what I was doing. Two years later, in 2019, my former Maths teacher offered a C course at my school. That's how I developed my programming skills and wrote my own little programs. Frustrated by being limited to the terminal and command line, I returned to Office and VBA, this time with much more programming experience.
about.webDevelopment: During lockdown, with all my friends gathering on Discord to play games, I wanted to create bots. That pushed me to study JavaScript and Node.js on my own. Since I had learned JavaScript, I decided to study HTML and CSS too. Ever since, I've loved the web, and it's how I create my websites, platforms, tools, bots, extensions and applications. Over these 5 years as a web developer, I've published several projects that I proudly maintain and that impact thousands of people.
about.currentInterests: My most successful project so far is Dicionário Bot, which has been used by over 1,500 different users. Along with developing my own projects, I also want to expand my knowledge, explore web development further and learn about native application development for mobile and desktop devices. When I'm not programming or studying for my next exam at the university, I'm chatting with friends, watching movies or shows, playing video games or listening to music.
